summary: Iteration 2 (Delivery Areas + fee/min_order in orders) fully tested. Backend: 37/37 pytest tests pass (23 regression + 14 new iter2). Frontend: admin /admin/areas CRUD + toggle works, Checkout area Select drives subtotal/taxa/total live, min-order warning + disabled Confirm work, submit-without-area blocked by toast, WhatsApp wa.me URL contains Subtotal/Taxa de entrega/Total/Bairro/Região, admin /admin/pedidos expanded view shows Região + Subtotal + Taxa de entrega + Total, old orders without new fields render without errors (backward compatible). No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/orders still trusts client-supplied unit_price (carried over from iter1) — a customer can send unit_price=0.01 to bypass the new min_order check (e.g., subtotal computed from items*qty using client price could be artificially high or low). Recommend resolving prices server-side from the products collection before computing subtotal/min_order.

server.py /api/admin/delivery-areas does not validate non-negative fee/min_order; admin could create a negative fee that yields total < subtotal. Add Pydantic ge=0 validators on DeliveryAreaIn.fee and min_order.
DeliveryAreas.jsx remove() uses window.confirm — works but inconsistent with the shadcn Dialog used elsewhere; consider AlertDialog for visual consistency.

Checkout.jsx — when areas.length === 0 the user can submit without an area (delivery_fee=0). This is the documented backward-compat behaviour and matches the backend, but worth a visible note in the UI for the operator who hasn't seeded any region.
Pre-existing (iter1): CORSMiddleware uses allow_origin_regex='https?://.*' with allow_credentials=True — still unsafe.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin areas CRUD, toggle active, checkout area select, min-order warning + disabled confirm, WhatsApp URL content, admin pedidos expanded breakdown — all verified end-to-end)

test_credentials: Admin admin@adega.com / admin123 (seeded). Customers created at runtime via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create a few TEST_ prefixed delivery areas (TEST_inactive_*, TEST_nullmin_*, TEST_upd_*, TEST_del_*, TEST_inact_order_*) and clean them up in a module-scope teardown fixture. UI test created and deleted one TEST_UI_<ts> area. The 5 seeded areas (Centro/Jardins/Vila Madalena/Pinheiros/Moema) were NOT modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (iter1) and /app/backend/tests/test_delivery_areas.py (iter2). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend critical flows verified: (1) /admin/areas CRUD + toggle, (2) /checkout area select drives Resumo (subtotal/checkout-delivery-fee/checkout-total) and min-order-warning + disables confirm-order-btn, (3) WhatsApp wa.me URL built via window.open contains *Subtotal*, *Taxa de entrega*, *Total*, *Bairro/Região*, (4) /admin/pedidos expanded panel shows Região, Subtotal, Taxa de entrega (Bairro), Total. Backend rejects inactive/missing area (400) and below-min-order (400, 'Pedido mínimo'). Order without delivery_area_id stays backward-compatible (delivery_fee=0, total=subtotal). No changes required to production code from this testing run.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found in iteration 2. Initial test attempt hit a transient empty admin table because the test goto'd /admin/areas before the login response settled cookies; re-running after a 2.5s wait showed all 5 seeded areas correctly. This was a test-timing issue, not a code issue.
